description: Calculate monthly take-home pay from a gross salary in Vietnam: employee social (8%), health (1.5%) and unemployment (1%) insurance with the ceilings for the date and region, family deductions (15.5 million VND for the taxpayer, 6.2 million per dependent), personal income tax by bracket (5-bracket scale 5% to 35%, or 20% flat for non-residents), net pay, and the employer contributions and total cost. Options: as_of (YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD, default today; month and date are accepted as synonyms), region I-IV or 1-4 (default I), dependents (residents only), residency resident|non_resident, nationality vietnamese|foreigner (foreigner = contract of 12 months or more: no unemployment insurance), insurance_base (if the insured salary differs from gross; not below the regional minimum), union_member (0.5% member fee, default false). Examples: {"gross":30000000}; {"gross":50000000,"dependents":2,"as_of":"2026-08","region":"II"}; {"gross":120000000,"nationality":"foreigner"}.

as_of.description: Date of the calculation: YYYY-MM (first day of that month) or YYYY-MM-DD. Default: today in Vietnam. Supported from 2026-01; earlier dates are rejected.

date.description: Synonym of as_of (same formats: YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD). Pass only one of as_of, month, date.

dependents.description: Number of registered dependents (0-20, default 0). Residents only: 6.2 million VND per dependent per month.

gross.description: Monthly gross salary in VND (whole number), e.g. 30000000.

insurance_base.description: Salary used for compulsory insurance, if different from gross. Must not be below the regional minimum wage; capped at the ceilings automatically.

month.description: Synonym of as_of (same formats: YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD). Pass only one of as_of, month, date.

nationality.description: "vietnamese" (default) or "foreigner" = foreign citizen with a labour contract of 12 months or more: social and health insurance, no unemployment insurance.

region.description: Regional minimum wage zone I, II, III or IV (default I); 1-4 and lower case are accepted. Chosen by the user; there is no locality lookup.

residency.description: Tax residency: "resident" (default; progressive scale with deductions) or "non_resident" (flat 20% of gross, no deductions).

union_member.description: Employee is a trade union member: deduct the 0.5% member fee (default false).

name: gross_to_net
title: Gross to net salary (Vietnam)
